description: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (fifteenth edition) — the English text the Christian Classics Ethereal Library publishes for this work, on the site's Hymns shelf. The record was created by the CCEL import from the site's own catalogue and plain text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's catalogue, whose shelves follow the site's own division of Christian literature, and whose transcription follows the print edition Edinburgh and London: Oliphant, Anderson, & Ferrier, 1910.
availabilityNote: Complete in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's plain-text edition: 2 chapter(s), 8 paragraph(s), 147 words. The divisions are the headings of the site's own text, which the library stores rather than asking the site for again when the work is read. The text is public domain and is displayed with the library's credit.

texts.2.1: BOSTON: TICKNOR AND FIELDS. M DCCC LXVI.
texts.2.2: Entered according to Act of Congress, in the year 1848, BY WM. D. TICKNOR & COMPANY, In the Clerk's Office of the District Court of Massachusetts.
texts.2.4: Among the Hymns in the following collection will be found many which are not of the commonly recognized metres. Some of these are already set to music of their own. Others can readily be adapted by the choir-leader to the simple chants which are now generally found in our collections of Sacred Music.
texts.2.5: An asterisk prefixed to the author's name indicates that some change has been made in the hymn by the present compilers.
texts.2.6: The titles of the Supplementary Hymns in the present edition have been introduced within the original table of contents, instead of forming a separate series at the end.
